title: Two-colour Zig-Zag Numberlink on rectangles
abstract: A Lean 4 proof that two-colour Zig-Zag Numberlink on rectangular grids (the paired 2-disjoint path cover problem: two vertex-disjoint paths s0 → t0 and s1 → t1 that together visit every cell) is decided by an explicit procedure, and that an explicit construction finds a solution whenever one exists. For both sides at least 11, an instance is solvable exactly when it passes a finite catalogue of forbidden patterns; for a side at most 10, a plug dynamic program decides it. The finite cases of the characterization are 21 boxes of slice certificates and 59 window certificates, all checked by the kernel.
